interpretation: Coarse molecular-wall hypotheses conditioned on registered outreach-image ridges and Zeigler 2013 HCO+ line centroids. The central ionized core and wider halo are separate. The 120–650 arcsec image region, search bounds, morphology/velocity loss scales, missing-ray penalty and neutral wall thickness are explicit engineering assumptions, not measured errors or density. The systemic reference is Meaburn's heliocentric −27.1±2 plus the 3.12 km/s conversion stated by Zeigler. No unique depth, hydrodynamic solution or calibrated flux is claimed.
